title: A League of Their Own
tagline: A woman's place is on home, first, second, and third.
about: A dairy-farm catcher and her kid sister join the women's professional baseball league set up while the men are away at war.

Sharp cheddar toasties with tomato relish.How to make it8 slices of sourdough200g vintage cheddar, grated60g butter, soft1 tsp Dijon mustard125ml tomato relishSpread the bread with mustard and pile the cheddar on half the slices, then close.Butter the outsides and toast in a pan over medium heat until golden and melting.Cut into fingers and serve with the relish.Betty Spaghetti meatball slidersBetty Spaghetti warming up to come in. Pork and beef meatballs in red sauce on soft rolls.How to make it250g beef mince250g pork mince40g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg30g parmesan, finely grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700ml tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano2 tbsp olive oil8 soft slider rolls4 slices of provoloneMix both minces with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic.Simmer gently until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce thickens.Tuck two meatballs and sauce into each roll with half a slice of provolone.Salted peanuts by the bagThrown up to the bleachers, all nine innings.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot StandSplits catch ballpark franksDottie catches a pop fly in the splits. Beef franks, slow onions, mustard and relish.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls2 brown onions, thinly sliced20g butter4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp sweet pickle relishCook the onions slowly in the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and golden.Grill the franks, turning, until blistered and hot through.Toast the rolls in the pan.Fill and top with onions, mustard and relish.Roadhouse night pulled pork rollsMarla meets Nelson on the roadhouse night. Smoky pulled pork, apple slaw and pickles.How to make it1.5kg pork shoulder, boneless2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml apple juice125ml smoky barbecue sauce8 soft white rolls1/4 green cabbage, finely shredded1 green apple, cut in matchsticks3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise16 dill pickle slicesRub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt and sit it in a lidded pot with the apple juice.Cover and cook at 160°C until it pulls apart easily.Shred the pork with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some pan juices.Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayo, then fill the rolls with pork, slaw and pickles.SweetsNo crying in baseball candy bar sliceThere's no crying in baseball. Chocolate, salted peanut and caramel slice.How to make it200g plain sweet biscuits, crushed100g butter, melted395g tin sweetened condensed milk60g golden syrup60g brown sugar120g salted roasted peanuts200g milk chocolate1 tbsp neutral oilMix the biscuit crumbs with half the butter and press into a lined slice tin.Stir the condensed milk, golden syrup, sugar and remaining butter over low heat until thick and golden.Stir in the peanuts, pour over the base and bake at 170°C for 10 minutes, then cool.Melt the chocolate with the oil, pour over and chill until set, then slice.Cold DrinksDon't tell Jimmy peach shandyJimmy was told not to drink.
